purpose: Teach: 雅子/恵子/静香/直人/健一/和夫/篤/哉

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、皇室の雅子様のお話を尊敬を込めて語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer spoke so respectfully about Empress Masako.
lines.style: Warm recollection, almost marveling. Slow, careful pace. Voice softens on the name. Gentle admiration without performance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の恵子さんとお茶されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer came in with her friend Keiko for tea.
lines.style: Observant, noticing the small relational detail. Soft, unhurried delivery. The tone of someone cataloguing a human moment they found settling.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の静香さんとご来店だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer visited with her friend Shizuka.
lines.style: Gentle, remembering. Slight warmth on the names. Pace is unhurried, as if Mei is holding the image for a moment before speaking it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の直人さんと打ち合わせされてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer was meeting with her friend Naoto for work.
lines.style: Noticing the purposefulness in the detail. Even tone, steady. A small recognition of someone attending to something that mattered.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、近所の健一さんが面白い方だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer mentioned her neighbor Kenichi — said he's quite funny.
lines.style: Soft amusement in the voice. A small smile underneath. Pace is light, the delight of noting when someone speaks fondly of another person.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お父様のお名前が和夫さんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer told me her father's name is Kazuo.
lines.style: Simple, matter-of-fact sharing. No presumption of significance. The way someone shares a detail they've been trusted with, held lightly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「篤志家、つまり篤志の方の支援活動」を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer spoke about philanthropic work — the kind of meaningful support that comes from genuine care.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly reverent. Voice steadies on the concept itself. Unhurried pace, the weight of something admirable held in the delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「快哉を叫ぶ場面」のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer shared a story about a moment of genuine triumph — raising a cry of joy.
lines.style: Warmth and wonder intertwined. Softer attack. Pace slows at the image itself. Trailing quiet at the end, as if letting the story settle.
